hook_line: INFOSYS IN TALKS WITH DOJ OVER H-1B FILINGS

hook_stat.sub: Quarter-end in the filing disclosing the DOJ probe

stats.label: Paid in 2013 to settle a US immigration probe
Visas at issue in the 2013 settlement allegations
No charge, settlement or finding in the current probe

diaspora_bullets: The probe concerns the employer's filings, not individual workers' status
Indian nationals receive the largest share of H-1B approvals
news_summary: Infosys is in discussions with the US Department of Justice over an investigation into how it classified certain H-1B visa holders in immigration filings.
payoff: Infosys said it cannot predict the outcome of the DOJ investigation.
